content: {"like":["Enjoys high-quality, visually striking content with strong cinematography and creative creature designs","Prefers live, raw performances over canned or noisy productions","Values films that inspire or influence other media (e.g., Rick & Morty)","Looks for movies with a blend of modern and classic elements (e.g., Yokai monsters with a Godzilla vibe)","Appreciates well-acted, memorable characters and engaging storytelling"],"dislike":["Dislikes poor sound quality and distracting audience noise","Avoids films with dated or thin animation and shallow plots","Rejects content that feels too juvenile or lacks depth in character development","Prefers not to watch movies with inconsistent or low-quality audio-visuals","Steers clear of films that are overly comedic in a style they find unappealing"]}
